notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
I'm happy to release the first update ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Change Log:[/h1]
[list]
  [*] Added resolution options to in game pause menu
  [*] Improved resolution dropdown
  [*] Added a different look for each upgrade level of the charging station
  [*] Game will now run in the background (when it is not the focussed window)
[/list]
